connectorUiConfig.title: Sophos Central (using REST API)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Sophos Central](https://www.sophos.com/en-us/products/sophos-central) data connector provides the capability to ingest security events and alerts from the Sophos Central SIEM API into Microsoft Sentinel. The connector polls the `/siem/v1/events` and `/siem/v1/alerts` endpoints to bring endpoint detections, threat activity, and security alerts into your workspace for correlation, analytics, and hunting.

sampleQueries.query:
SophosEvents_CL
 | summarize count() by EventType
 | top 10 by count_

SophosAlerts_CL
 | where Severity == "high"
 | sort by TimeGenerated desc

dataTypes.name: SophosEvents_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SophosEvents_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: SophosAlerts_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
SophosAlerts_CL
 | summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
 | where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

customs.name: Sophos Central API credentials
customs.description: A Sophos Central API Client ID and Client Secret are required. Create an API Credential from the Sophos Central admin console under **Global Settings** > **API Credentials Management**.

instructionSteps.title: Connect Sophos Central to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Provide the Sophos Central API Client ID and Client Secret to authenticate and begin collecting events and alerts.

>**NOTE:** This connector uses the Sophos Central SIEM API. Ensure you have created an API Credential in the Sophos Central admin console (**Global Settings** > **API Credentials Management**) with access to the SIEM integration.
